label: ACCEPT
reason: Every form class in forms.py files (UserAddressForm, BasketLineForm, DashboardProductReviewForm, BankcardForm) ends in Form, while co-located fields, widgets and mixins use their own suffixes; no outliers. A form class without the suffix would not be caught (flake8 has no naming plugin, pylintrc disables the C naming checks), and it is a deliberate naming scheme worth flagging.
